en.headline: Broadway musical Charlie and the Chocolate Factory opens in Hong Kong tomorrow
en.dek: The production based on Roald Dahl’s novel runs at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre from 4 November to 6 December, tickets from HK$388.
body: The Broadway musical adaptation of Roald Dahl’s Charlie and the Chocolate Factory opens on Wednesday at the Grand Theatre of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Produced by Broadway International Group and presented in association with Broadway Asia and other partners, the show features Daniel Plimpton as Willy Wonka, with young actors alternating in the role of Charlie Bucket. It runs for about 145 minutes including a 20-minute intermission and is performed in English with Traditional Chinese surtitles.

Ticket prices range from HK$388 to HK$1,288 according to the day and seating category. Following strong demand, eight additional performances were added, extending the run to 6 December. No performances are scheduled on Mondays.
The organisers said the production brings the story’s stagecraft and music to Hong Kong audiences for a limited season.

zh.headline: 百老匯音樂劇《朱古力獎門人》明日香港開演
zh.dek: 改編自羅爾德·達爾小說的製作由11月4日至12月6日在香港文化中心大劇院上演，票價由388港元起。
body: 百老匯音樂劇《朱古力獎門人》將於周三在尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院開演。
這部由Broadway International Group製作、與Broadway Asia等夥伴呈獻的演出，由Daniel Plimpton飾演威利·旺卡，小演員輪流飾演查理·巴克特。全場約145分鐘，包括20分鐘中場休息，以英語演出並附繁體中文字幕。
票價視乎日期及座位由388港元至1,288港元。因需求殷切，已加開八場，演出延至12月6日。逢星期一休息。
主辦方表示，這次有限檔期的製作把故事的舞台效果與音樂帶到香港觀眾面前。
